title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) is μ ≈ 0.52.

title: Correct spring energy
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) is E_pm ≈ 24.4 J.

title: Work-energy setup for μ
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly for the full A→D path, accounting for initial kinetic energy, gravitational work, and friction work over the total sliding distance.

title: Energy conservation for E_pm
description: Important: Applies energy conservation (or work-energy) for the A→C path to relate initial energy, gravitational potential change, friction work, and the final spring energy.

title: Correct total distance for friction
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total sliding distance for friction in part (1) as l_AB + 2*l_BC + (l_AB - l_AD) for the A→D trip.

title: Correct AC distance for part (2)
description: Important: Uses the correct distance l_AC = l_AB + l_BC when calculating energy changes up to maximum compression (point C).

title: Trigonometric function application
description: Optional: Correctly uses sinθ for gravitational potential changes and cosθ for the normal force (and thus friction) on the incline.

title: Sign error in energy terms
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error when setting up the work-energy equation, e.g., incorrectly adding/subtracting friction work or gravitational work.

title: Incorrect friction distance
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sliding distance for friction work (e.g., omitting the double compression distance l_BC or the return distance l_AB - l_AD).
